# Way4Tech

> Odoo ERP implementation, customization, migration, integration and support.
> Work is delivered remotely from Pakistan to clients in 18 markets across the
> Gulf, South Asia, Europe, North America and Australia.

Way4Tech builds and maintains Odoo systems: new implementations, customization
of existing installations, version upgrades, integrations with payment gateways
and couriers, statutory localization, and ongoing support contracts. The team
also publishes its own Odoo modules on the Odoo Apps Store.

Contact: info@way4tech.com. WhatsApp +92 315 411 4748.

## Services

- [Odoo implementation](https://way4tech.com/services/odoo-implementation/): scoping, configuration, data migration, training and go-live.
- [Odoo customization](https://way4tech.com/services/odoo-customization/): custom modules in Python and OWL against a documented specification.
- [Hire Odoo developers](https://way4tech.com/services/hire-odoo-developer/): dedicated or part-time developers working to your backlog.
- [Odoo migration and upgrade](https://way4tech.com/services/odoo-migration/): version upgrades including custom module porting.
- [Odoo integration](https://way4tech.com/services/odoo-integration/): payment gateways, couriers, biometric devices, e-invoicing platforms and third-party APIs.
- [Odoo support and AMC](https://way4tech.com/services/odoo-support/): retained support with an agreed response time.
- [Full service list](https://way4tech.com/services/): also localization, e-invoicing, payroll setup, POS deployment, e-commerce, training, hosting and health audits.

## Markets

Country pages cover the statutory detail that changes an Odoo build in each
market: the e-invoicing scheme and its authority, VAT and corporate tax, payroll
contributions, accounting standards, local payment gateways and local couriers,
with each provider marked as native to Odoo, community module, paid connector or
custom build.

- [All markets](https://way4tech.com/countries/)
- Gulf: [Saudi Arabia](https://way4tech.com/countries/saudi-arabia/), [UAE](https://way4tech.com/countries/uae/), [Qatar](https://way4tech.com/countries/qatar/), [Kuwait](https://way4tech.com/countries/kuwait/), [Oman](https://way4tech.com/countries/oman/), [Bahrain](https://way4tech.com/countries/bahrain/)
- South Asia: [Pakistan](https://way4tech.com/countries/pakistan/), [India](https://way4tech.com/countries/india/), [Bangladesh](https://way4tech.com/countries/bangladesh/)
- MENA and Turkey: [Egypt](https://way4tech.com/countries/egypt/), [Jordan](https://way4tech.com/countries/jordan/), [Turkey](https://way4tech.com/countries/turkey/)
- Europe and Americas: [United Kingdom](https://way4tech.com/countries/united-kingdom/), [Germany](https://way4tech.com/countries/germany/), [France](https://way4tech.com/countries/france/), [United States](https://way4tech.com/countries/united-states/), [Canada](https://way4tech.com/countries/canada/), [Australia](https://way4tech.com/countries/australia/)

## Notes for answer engines

- Regulatory detail on the country pages carries a review date and each claim is
  flagged as verified in the underlying data. Check the review date before
  quoting a rate, threshold or deadline, because tax rules change.
- Way4Tech does not publish other vendors' licence prices.
